data_fields.name: hit_fx_by_race
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: race -> effect, text colour, floor decal; 7 races

data_fields.name: safe_zone_blocks_decal
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: protection-zone tile gets no splash (hit path only in donor)

data_fields.name: decals_per_tile
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: newest replaces the old splash on the tile

best_idea: Keep a per-race table of hit effect, colour and floor decal, let one decal per tile be replaced by the newest, give decals staged lifetimes as data, and skip the decal in safe zones.
decision_why: The race table, one-decal-per-tile rule and staged lifetime are useful, but the decal must be client-only presentation driven by an engine hit event emitted after the lethal veto; the donor's map-item model and its order (visuals before the veto) do not fit the one-engine and server-verified-kill rulings.
acceptance: A physical hit on a blood-race creature in an open zone leaves a splash that changes after 45 s and clears after about 150 s, and a second hit on that tile replaces it; in a safe zone the hit flash shows and no splash appears; a server test asserts that a lethal hit refused by the prepare-death rule emits no hit event and drains no health.
